summary: Implemented prepareUpdate for SPARQL Update, without running tests or committing. Changes: (1) rdflib/plugins/sparql/sparql.py: added the Update container (prologue, algebra) beside Query. (2) rdflib/plugins/sparql/algebra.py: translateUpdate always returns an Update; the prologue is built from the first declaration group before the empty-request early exit, so declarations-only requests keep their PREFIX/BASE bindings; Update is imported from sparql.py. (3) rdflib/plugins/sparql/update.py: evalUpdate iterates update.algebra and its docstring says it takes an Update. (4) rdflib/plugins/sparql/processor.py: added prepareUpdate after prepareQuery, recording _original_args. (5) rdflib/plugins/sparql/__init__.py: exports prepareUpdate. (6) test/test_sparql_prepare.py (new): covers prepare then Graph.update, reuse across graphs and repeated application, initNs, initial bindings, direct evaluation, container shape, empty and declarations-only requests, empty string via Graph.update/processUpdate, and a no-mutation snapshot check. SPARQLUpdateProcessor.update needed no change. Caveats: nothing was executed, so tests and black formatting are unverified. On the non-empty path, the first declaration group is applied twice (idempotent, but redundant). pprintAlgebra in the DAWG test still works with the container.
